description.zh: 给猫起名 Vincent，给自己选了“列奥纳多”。这里写阅读、历史、生活、写作，以及做自己的软件。
description.en: I named my cat Vincent, so I guess I'm Leonardo.

tagline.zh: 阅读、历史、写作，以及做自己的软件
tagline.en: Reading, history, writing, and building my own software

description.zh: 为什么写不出来、怎么开始写长文，以及笔记、flomo 和读书笔记这些把想法留下来的办法。
description.en: Why writing is hard, how to start long-form pieces, and the notes, flomo and reading notes that keep ideas around.

description.zh: 作为产品经理，用 AI 写代码、做自己的小工具：Command Reopen、静态站点、openflomo，以及“只解决自己的问题”。
description.en: Vibe-coding my own tools as a product manager: Command Reopen, static sites, openflomo, and solving only your own problems.

description.zh: 读了什么、怎么读：书单、读书评分，以及对“阅读是一种偷懒”的反思。
description.en: What I read and how: book lists, ratings, and second thoughts on reading as a form of laziness.

description.zh: 用笨办法读历史：顾维钧、中晚唐到宋的藩镇，以及编年体读法。
description.en: Reading history the slow way: Wellington Koo, regional warlords from late Tang to Song, and chronological reading.

description.zh: 关于意义、工作和年龄的焦虑，以及怎样把日子过得更有实感。
description.en: On meaning, work and age anxiety, and how to make everyday life feel more real.

description.zh: 每年一篇的个人总结：读过的书、玩过的游戏、家里多了一只猫，以及这一年想明白的事。
description.en: One personal review a year: books, games, a new cat, and what the year taught me.
